title: stakeholder-pocket-count-and-priority-census-jul-2026
summary: One-page, lightweight spreadsheet used during a 1-week rapid scan to enumerate cross-functional stakeholder pockets, current coverage (soft owners vs. formal owners), priority for handoff or escalation, and immediate blockers. Built to support a fast operations sync and to generate a short list of actionable follow-ups for the week-of Jul 12 2026.
